q: What is the carbon footprint of a PUF sandwich panel?
title: PUF sandwich panel footprint
short: Most of it comes from the steel skins and the polyurethane foam, made from MDI and polyol. The blowing agent matters too: HFC blowing agents are strong greenhouse gases, while hydrocarbons such as cyclopentane are not. Ask suppliers for each, then add your press and curing energy per square metre.
audience: Cold room, clean room and prefab building panel makers

ul: Coated steel or aluminium skins, by weight.
Blowing agent type and quantity, including any released during foaming.

p: HFC releases during foaming count in your Scope 1. Ask buyers whether they want the agent named in the declaration.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol standards, including the Product Standard
